{{Short description|Indian digital cinema distribution network}} {{Use dmy dates|date=October 2017}} {{Use Indian English|date=October 2017}} {{Infobox company | image = UFO_logo.jpg | type = [[Public company|Public]] | traded_as = {{Unbulleted list|{{BSE|539141}}|{{NSE|UFO}}}} | industry = [[Advertising media selection|Cinema advertising]] | hq_location_city = [[Mumbai]] | hq_location_country = India | area_served = Worldwide | founded = 2004 | founder = Sanjay Shankar Gaikwad
Narendra Hete | key_people = Sanjay Shankar Gaikwad ([[Managing Director]]){{cite web|title=Executive Profile: Sanjay Shankar Gaikwad|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/person.asp?personId=31267046&privcapId=31138435|publisher=bloomberg.com|access-date=13 March 2018}} | website = {{URL|http://www.ufomoviez.com/}} }} '''UFO Moviez India Limited''' is an Indian [[digital cinema]] distribution network and an in-cinema advertising platform.{{cite news|title=UFO Moviez's theatre arm to start operations next month|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/ufo-moviezs-theatre-arm-to-start-operations-next-month/article9163751.ece|access-date=13 March 2018|work=The Hindu|publisher=thehindubusinessline.com|date=29 September 2016}} It operates a satellite-based digital cinema distribution network using its UFO-M4 platform and D-Cinema network. UFO Moviez is a company in the business of electronic delivery of digitized full-length feature films and content in theatres via satellite. UFO has also contributed to the revival of [[Movie theater|single screen cinemas]] in India and its secure technology has substantially reduced Piracy. UFO has ensured that audiences have ‘day of release’ access to films everywhere. UFO Moviez claimed to have released more than 11,000 films in 22 languages, on its UFO M4-Platform and [[Digital Cinema Initiatives|DCI]] Network and has conducted over 21 million shows.{{cite web |date=26 June 2017 |title=UFO Moviez India Ltd – India's largest digital cinema distribution network and in-cinema advertising platform |url=http://www.lifeandequities.com/ufo-moviez-india-ltd-indias-largest-digital-cinema-distribution-network-and-in-cinema-advertising-platform/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180313155210/http://www.lifeandequities.com/ufo-moviez-india-ltd-indias-largest-digital-cinema-distribution-network-and-in-cinema-advertising-platform/ |archive-date=2018-03-13 |access-date=13 March 2018 |publisher=lifeandequities.com}} == History == Founded in 2005, UFO Moviez has been promoted by Valuable Group led by Sanjay Gaikwad & Narendra Hete and Apollo International Limited led by Kanwar Raaja. Valuable Group is, amongst other businesses, engaged in the digital cinema space, film distribution business and delivers, stores and plays movies in private theatres. Apollo International has different business segments such as international trading of tyres, various commodities, products and services, manufacturing and export of leather garments and logistics.{{Cite web|url=https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/1419220339596.pdf|title=UFO Moviez History}} In 2007, 3i Private Equity invested US$22mn. with an aim of funding the company's expansion plans. In 2011, Providence Equity Partners provided growth capital by investing US$60mn. in primary and secondary capital.{{Cite news|url=https://www.vccircle.com/providence-equity-partners-invests-rs-260-cr-ufo-moviez/|title=Providence Equity Partners Invests Rs 260 Cr In UFO Moviez|date=2011-04-18|work=VCCircle|access-date=2018-06-04|language=en-US}} In 2011, UFO acquired controlling stake in South India based Southern Digital Solutions (SDS) and the only DCI System Integrator in India – Scrabble Entertainment.{{Cite news|url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/international-news/ufo-moviez-commits-rs-2bn-for-scrabble-entertainment%E2%80%99s-india-expansion-113102206713_1.html|title=UFO Moviez commits Rs.2bn for Scrabble Entertainment's India expansion|last=indiainfoline.com|access-date=2018-06-04|language=en}} In 2015, UFO Moviez made a stellar debut on Indian Bourses. == Products == === Digital Cinema System === UFO-M4 is UFO's satellite-based, E-Cinema movie delivery platform.{{cite web |url=http://www.sebi.gov.in/cms/sebi_data/attachdocs/1419220339596.pdf |title=Draft Red Herring Prospectus |website=www.sebi.gov.in |access-date=2014-12-22 |date=December 18, 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141231114501/http://www.sebi.gov.in/cms/sebi_data/attachdocs/1419220339596.pdf |archive-date=2014-12-31 |url-status=dead}} ==References== {{Reflist|colwidth=30em}} {{DEFAULTSORT:UFO Moviez}} [[Category:Film distributors of India]] [[Category:Technology companies of India]] [[Category:Film production companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Mass media companies established in 2004]] [[Category:2004 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
